extracted.intended_audience: prospective grantees, partners, job seekers, and the general public interested in MacArthur Foundation priorities
extracted.subtask_description: Organizational ‘About’ page describing the MacArthur Foundation’s mission, core values, focus areas, programs, operational expectations, and contact/offices — useful for prospective applicants and partners to assess alignment with funding priorities and organizational standards.

rubrics_metrics.name: Mission: build a more just, verdant, and peaceful world
rubrics_metrics.description: We are committed to building a more just, verdant, and peaceful world.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The Foundation frames its work around this mission; prospective work or proposals should align with advancing justice, environmental health, and peace as core goals.

rubrics_metrics.name: Focus area: climate change
rubrics_metrics.description: Including the existential threats of climate change.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Climate change is explicitly named as a pressing social issue the Foundation seeks to address; projects addressing climate-related risks and solutions are a stated priority.

rubrics_metrics.name: Focus area: criminal justice reform
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Criminal justice reform is a named priority area for transformative change and potential funding consideration.

rubrics_metrics.name: Focus area: revitalizing local news in the U.S.
rubrics_metrics.description: Revitalizing local news in the U.S.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The Foundation has a historic commitment to journalism and specifically calls out strengthening local news as an area of focus.

rubrics_metrics.name: Focus area: expanding who creates, uses, and benefits from artificial intelligence
rubrics_metrics.description: Expanding who creates, uses, and benefits from artificial intelligence.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The Foundation prioritizes work that broadens inclusion around AI development, application, and benefit — projects that increase equitable participation and mitigate harms are implied priorities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Focus area: strengthening the well-being of Native communities
rubrics_metrics.description: Strengthening the well-being of Native communities.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Support for Native communities' wellbeing is explicitly named; proposals addressing tribal/community needs and priorities align with Foundation interests.

rubrics_metrics.name: Focus area: empowering young people in Nigeria
rubrics_metrics.guidance: MacArthur identifies specific geographic/programmatic attention to youth in Nigeria; initiatives in that country targeting youth empowerment are within scope.

rubrics_metrics.name: Commitment to transformative change and creative solutions
rubrics_metrics.description: The MacArthur Foundation boldly invests in creative solutions to urgent challenges, sparking hope for our future. We strive toward transformative change on some of the world's most pressing social issues.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Preference for bold, creative, and potentially transformative interventions rather than incremental approaches; proposals that demonstrate ambition and potential system-level impact are favored.

rubrics_metrics.name: Just Imperative: lead with a commitment to justice
rubrics_metrics.description: We live our mission through the Just Imperative, which charges us to lead with a commitment to justice.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Work supported by the Foundation should be consistent with and advance justice; the Just Imperative is an organizing principle guiding decisions and priorities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Values-based decision making and trust-based relationships
rubrics_metrics.description: Our values represent a core set of beliefs that guide how our organization conducts itself and builds trust-based relationships with partners and grantees. Our values guide our decisions, behaviors, and reflect how we seek to serve our communities and work together.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applicants should expect the Foundation to evaluate fit not only on programmatic grounds but on alignment with stated values and capacity to engage in trust-based partnerships.

rubrics_metrics.name: Historic commitment to journalism and democratic accountability
rubrics_metrics.description: In addition to our award programs, ... the Foundation continues our historic commitments to the role of journalism in a responsible and responsive democracy.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Projects strengthening journalism’s capacity to serve democracy are an explicit area of interest.

rubrics_metrics.name: Increase financial capital for the social sector and strengthen research/advocacy on social impacts of technology
rubrics_metrics.description: We are also significantly increasing financial capital for the social sector and strengthening research and advocacy about the social impacts of technology.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The Foundation prioritizes initiatives that expand funding capacity for social-sector organizations and build evidence/advocacy around technology’s societal effects.

rubrics_metrics.name: Award programs: MacArthur Fellows and 100&Change
rubrics_metrics.description: In addition to our award programs, MacArthur Fellows and 100&Change, the Foundation continues our historic commitments ...
rubrics_metrics.guidance: These named programs represent major funding mechanisms; applicants should consult program-specific criteria (not detailed on this page) for eligibility and submission rules.

rubrics_metrics.name: High professional and ethical standards; Code of Conduct
rubrics_metrics.description: MacArthur Staff and Directors are expected to conduct themselves with the highest professional and ethical standards. Our Code of Conduct emphasizes a number of policies and procedures to comply with our organizational standards.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The Foundation expects compliance with formal policies and ethical norms in engagements; grantees and partners should anticipate adherence to such standards in collaborations and reporting.

rubrics_metrics.name: Staff diversity and inclusion
rubrics_metrics.description: Progress is possible when we include all voices in the work to support individuals and organizations working directly to address our most pressing social challenges. We believe the work is better because of our staff’s diverse backgrounds, viewpoints, and lived experiences.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Diversity, equity, and inclusion are operational priorities; the Foundation values inclusive teams and may consider diversity and lived experience relevant when assessing partnerships or organizational capacity.

rubrics_metrics.name: Operational transparency: financials, investments, policies and offices/contact points
rubrics_metrics.description: Operational Information ... Financials & Investments ... Our Policies ... Offices and Contact Information (Chicago Headquarters, MacArthur in Nigeria, MacArthur in India).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The Foundation provides operational details and contact points for grants management and inquiries; prospective applicants should use provided contacts and review financial/policy pages for procedural and governance information.
